title: Chapter 57 — From First Project to Account
intro: The consolidation sequence that converts one proven project into standing flow.

sections.title: One Project Is Not an Account
sections.content:
Winning the first project is the beginning. Converting it into a standing relationship requires deliberate follow-through: flawless execution, proactive communication, a post-project review, and an explicit ask for the next one.

The consolidation question: 'Now that you have seen how we operate, would it make sense to route your upcoming projects through us?'

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating consolidation, ask:

Does the salesperson follow up after the first project with a review and forward ask?
Is execution on the first project flawless — or does it create concerns?
Are trial projects converting to standing accounts — or staying one-offs?
